newsitem.title: USA: Foxmeyer sells Foxmeyer Canada stake.
newsitem.headline: Foxmeyer sells Foxmeyer Canada stake.

text.p: FoxMeyer Health Corp said on Tuesday Gordon Capital has agreed to buy 14.25 million special warrants that are convertible into FoxMeyer Canada Inc shares for C$4.85 per warrant.
The deal, which is set to close September 20, 1996, will result in the disposition of FoxMeyer Health's entire stake in FoxMeyer Canada and generate US$38 million after expenses, the company said.
Also, FoxMeyer Canada has agreed to acquire FoxMeyer Health's U.S. HealthData Interchange Inc and part of the company's remaining CareStream operations, FoxMeyer said.
FoxMeyer said it expects to receive US$6 million in cash and a US$4 million note from Foxmeyer Canada in the deal.
FoxMeyer, which expects to report capital gains on the deals, said the transactions are consistent with plans to monetize its holdings.
